about_the_game:
Back in the year 2007, a game released on store shelves called "Marshmallow Land", developed by industry newcomer IntelleCo Games. The game was known for its complicated development history, especially the huge delay that occurred due to a massive chemical leak in the office building. It didn't sell very well, and after only a mere two months, was removed from all stores. IntelleCo Games was dissolved, and the game faded into obscurity.

Until now.

Marshmallow Land: Definitive Edition is a fresh new official update to the original game, featuring:

  • Entirely reworked art, in a signature grayscale style

  • 40+ entertaining levels

  • Completely new soundtrack

and...

Who am I kidding with this?

Ever since we've started working on this, everything has been acting up. Developer's computers doing things when they're not there, files mysteriously appearing on their desktops. I shouldn't be telling you this, but please exercise caution. Don't play the game. Something is seriously wrong with it.

The Truth

Marshmallow Land: Definitive Edition is a puzzle platformer with meta-horror elements. Created as an official remake of "Marshmallow Land" by GenieCMD, it aims to provide an immersive horror experience along with great gameplay and storytelling. Watch the game deteriorate before you eyes.

It actually features:

  • A slow-burn horror atmosphere

  • 15 total levels

  • Meta mind-bending puzzles

  • Meta elements inspired by IMSCARED and KinitoPET

content_descriptors.notes: Marshmallow Land: Definitive Edition is not a game designed for children. It contains occasional scenes of blood and gore.
